title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisons of G .L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 524 for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's cutomers puruant to meter readings in the billing months of December, 1988, January and February, 1989. Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Depatment of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 586.
